Brief from the lead:
Pull these facts from the record, verbatim: fare type (refundable or nonrefundable); itinerary (domestic or international); event type (cancellation or schedule change); schedule movement in minutes for departure and for arrival; whether the traveler accepted the alternative; hours since booking; days before departure when booked; and any medical or bereavement claim. Report missing items as missing. Do not decide eligibility.

fare: nonrefundable
itinerary: domestic
event: schedule-change
schedule moved by: 200 minutes
traveler accepted the alternative: no
hours since booking: 400
booking was made this many days before departure: 30

State only the facts the brief asks for. At most 80 words.
